tools.name: pomodoro
tools.description: Plan pomodoro sessions. Calculates total time, break schedule, and estimated finish time. Use for questions like 'how long is 4 pomodoros' or 'plan 6 pomodoro sessions'.

work_minutes.description: Work duration per session in minutes (default: 25)

long_break_after.description: Take a long break after this many sessions (default: 4)

tools.name: random_pick
tools.description: Randomly pick one or more items from a comma-separated list. Use for 'pick a number between 1 and 10', 'choose a restaurant: pizza, sushi, tacos', or 'random movie from my list'.

items.description: Comma-separated list of items to pick from, e.g. 'pizza, sushi, tacos, burgers'

tools.name: dice_roll
tools.description: Roll dice in standard notation. Use for 'roll a d20', 'roll 3d6', 'roll 2d8+4', or 'roll percentile'.

notation.description: Dice notation: NdS+M where N=count, S=sides, M=modifier. Examples: '1d20', '3d6', '2d8+4', '1d100', '4d6' (for rolling stats). Also supports multiple dice like '2d6, 2d6, 2d6, 2d6, 2d6, 2d6'.

tools.name: coin_flip
tools.description: Flip a coin. Use for yes/no decisions or 'best of N' series. Returns heads or tails with count statistics.

flips.description: Number of flips (default: 1). Use 3 or 5 for 'best of N'.

tools.name: random_number
tools.description: Generate random numbers. Use for 'give me a random number between 1 and 100', 'pick 6 lottery numbers', or 'generate a random 4-digit PIN'.

count.description: How many numbers to generate (default: 1). Set to 6 for lottery-style.

unique.description: Whether numbers must be unique (default: false)

tools.name: password_generate
tools.description: Generate a strong random password with configurable length and character sets. Use when the user needs a password, API key, or secure token.
